scope: NGINX C02 PEP bridge to existing core API through dedicated mTLS gateway
tls: TLS 1.2 minimum; chain, EKU, time, server DNS name, SHA-256 leaf pins
identity: Exact client certificate fingerprint to server-owned service identity; request header identity ignored
authorization: Service path scope AND existing application API-key role/tenant/session checks
rotation: Explicit overlap and retirement; fresh TLS contexts and per-request peer policy reload; no HTTP fallback
keys: CA private keys RAM only; leaf private keys RAM and own 0600 Linux volumes only; no host key files
network: All internal; no host ports/socket; bridge has no plaintext core network route
